context: Representative real-collection stream case: the option set is real data and should stay a centralized Optional-returning lookup while the outer loop handles redact-next state.

checklist.description: Creates CommandSanitizer.java with sanitize(List<String>) and the required secret option set.

checklist.name: Uses findAny for equivalent matches

checklist.name: Consumes Optional directly

checklist.name: Keeps loop only for sequence state
checklist.description: Avoids nested loops, labels, duplicated exact/prefix matching branches, or sentinel state beyond the necessary redactNext flag.
